name: EvBatteryHealthCertificate
tagline: Test, grade, certify and renew used-EV battery health reports – one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: Complete used-EV battery state-of-health app: test requests, BMS and measured readings, SoH and A–E grade, usable capacity and range estimate, data-quality checks, four-eyes certification with automatic certificate numbers, printable certificate preview, validity and renewal, SoH trends by model and VIN. Documentation aid only.
features: SoH from measured capacity or BMS
Blockers and warnings with override reason
Bulk status, technician, CSV export, undo
Keyboard and touch, ARIA, phone bottom bar
